answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 17 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 507 identities costs 507 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The opal test is the live device, the grove test is the locked stake, and the quartz test is the graded history no template can fake.
